question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Forgiveness"** means the action or process of forgiving or being forgiven; it reflects compassion and letting go of resentment. (क्षमा)

 
 
• **Example:** Her forgiveness helped mend the broken relationship with her friend.
 
 
 
• In the context of the passage, **“Forgiveness”** completes the idea that forgiving an injury can even transform a foe into a friend.
 
 
• **Example:** Forgiveness can turn hostility into understanding and friendship.
 
 
 
• Hence, **‘Forgiveness’** is the most appropriate word to fill blank number 5.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fondness** (पसंद / लगाव): A liking or affection for someone or something.

 
 
• **Example:** He has a fondness for classical music.
 
 
 
• **Coyness** (लज्जालु / झिझक): Shyness or modesty, often in a playful or flirtatious way.
 
 
• **Example:** Her coyness made her appear mysterious to everyone.
 
 
 
• **Boldness** (साहस / निडरता): Willingness to take risks; confidence and courage.
 
 
• **Example:** His boldness in negotiations impressed the clients.
